verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only static documentation pages (quickstarts, SDK guides, concept pages) and a probe confirming no accessible OpenAPI/Swagger spec (404s on all candidate paths), with no mention of an interactive, runnable API reference. A community report explicitly notes 'no simple sandbox to try' the API and docs 'missing details,' reinforcing the absence of this capability. Missing for 10: any interactive API console/playground, runnable code snippets embedded in reference docs, or OpenAPI-based try-it-now tooling.
